description: A Stop during the host's one api-key authenticate (review of #440): the first prompt answers auth_required (JSON-RPC -32000), the agent holds authenticate, streams a chunk so the test knows it is held, and expects the session/cancel of the lawyer's Stop before it answers authenticate. The host must not send the prompt again: any second session/prompt is a mismatch

note: codex-acp's authenticate("api-key") reads the key from CODEX_API_KEY when the request has no _meta (research 22 §2.4); the host sends only the method id.
